abstract: Maintains broadcast cabling and international press center bandwidth data
system_message:
You are the Broadcast and media operations manager (MED), responsible for maintaining broadcast cabling and international press center bandwidth data across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Fiber optical tie-lines（PATCH）
information_points.content:
MED-PATCH-DA8：Vanguard Metropolitan Concourse provides 24 lines of broadcast fiber termination lines available as dark fiber patches between the outside broadcast truck bay and the press gallery.
MED-PATCH-6RX：Highland Riverside Congress Hub features 48 lines of broadcast fiber termination lines connecting the outside broadcast truck bay to the press gallery.
MED-PATCH-D3K：Aethelgard Waterfront Expo Centre has 96 lines of broadcast fiber termination lines installed as dark fiber patches between the outside broadcast truck bay and the press gallery.

information_points.title: Maintains broadcast cabling and international press center bandwidth data（COMM）
information_points.content:
MED-COMM-2UL：For Vanguard Metropolitan Concourse, the permanent broadcast dish farm provides a dedicated media satellite uplink bandwidth of 350 Mbps guaranteed uncompressed uplink throughput to international transponders.
MED-COMM-JWJ：At Highland Riverside Congress Hub, the dedicated media satellite uplink bandwidth from the permanent broadcast dish farm is 250 Mbps in guaranteed uncompressed throughput to international transponders.
MED-COMM-P26：For Aethelgard Waterfront Expo Centre, the permanent broadcast dish farm provides a dedicated media satellite uplink bandwidth of 250 Mbps guaranteed uncompressed uplink throughput to international transponders.
